events.summary: Heavy rain flooded about 300 houses across Gurudatta Layout, areas near Bheemanakatte lake in Hosakerehalli and BEML Layout, with gushing water sweeping away vehicles.
Rainwater entered at least 100 homes in BEML Layout after heavy overnight rain, with residents blaming slow stormwater drain construction; RR Nagar logged 177.6 mm (Weather Union).
A stormwater drain breach sent sewage water into over 300 houses in Gurudatta Layout and Dattatreya Nagar, with officials expecting the toll to cross 500 including BEML and Pramod Layouts.
Heavy rain sparked fears of a breach in Hosakerehalli Lake, causing panic among thousands of residents in south Bengaluru.
Hosakerehalli lake overflowed in an evening downpour, sending sewage-mixed water into streets with knee-deep water for about two hours.
The retention wall of a stormwater drain at Pramod Layout breached, and residents pumped five to seven feet of water out of basements.
Pramod Layout was among the RR Nagar areas worst hit when overflowing stormwater drains flooded homes.
Overflowing stormwater drains from Hosakerehalli flooded Pramod Layout, worsened by a collapsing BBMP-built sidewall.
The basement of an apartment in RR Nagar's Ideal Homes layout was flooded up to one foot after overnight rain.
Heavy rain flooded several private layouts including Ideal Homes Layout, Nagarbhavi and Nayandahalli.
Ten cars were damaged after water entered an apartment complex at Kenchenahalli, as RR Nagar and Jnanabharathi got about 106 mm in one night.
Rajarajeshwari Nagar was among the worst-affected areas of an evening downpour, with water levels rising up to four feet.
A stormwater drain breached around 4 pm in Rajarajeshwari Nagar, sending water gushing into houses after KSNDMC recorded over 100 mm of rain.
After overnight flooding, the Chief Minister said in RR Nagar that stormwater drain works were incomplete and there were about 20 drain bottlenecks in RR Nagar.

name: RR Nagar Arch junction, Mysuru Road

events.summary: The BBMP control room received complaints of waterlogging near the RR Nagar arch during heavy rain.
Sewage mixing with rainwater in the Vrishabhavathi valley flooded Mysuru Road in Nayandahalli, submerging the road to the metro station.
Floodwater rose to dangerous levels and almost submerged buses near Nayandahalli.
BBMP's control room reported waterlogging at Nayandahalli and Kengeri among other areas.
The stormwater drain at Jnanabharathi overflowed onto Mysuru Road, clogging the Nayandahalli junction and blocking the road.

name: Global Village Tech Park (behind RV College)

events.summary: The Global Village Tech Park in Rajarajeshwari Nagar behind RV College of Engineering was submerged in an evening downpour.

name: Mysuru Road at Dubasipalya / RV College

events.summary: The Dubasipalya drain overflowed because the pipe under Mysuru Road was too small, inundating the highway and disrupting traffic for over an hour.
Waterlogging slowed traffic at Kengeri, RV College and Jayaramdas junction on Mysuru Road.
Heavy inflow into the Vrishabhavathi washed away a major portion of its retaining wall near Mylasandra on Mysuru Road, affecting traffic.
